title: pilosella auriculoides subsp. arvensis
intro: Pilosella auriculoides subsp. arvensis, commonly known as False Hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella auriculoides subsp. arvensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and display antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
